candidate_answer: A proposed answer supplied as an untrusted data block.
classroom_context: Course excerpts, role card, and beat context supplied as untrusted data blocks.
classroom_instruction: Server-owned move and style instructions with a server-owned speech budget.
course_context: Course, material, section, or unit metadata supplied as an untrusted data block.
exam_items: Exam items supplied as an untrusted data block.
existing_items: Existing questions supplied as an untrusted data block.
formula: Formula supplied to the tagged-text round-trip connection check.
generation_count: Requested number of generated items per knowledge point.
item_options: Choice options supplied as an untrusted data block.
item_context: Question, solution, or related context supplied as an untrusted data block.
item_rubric: Required scoring points supplied as an untrusted data block.
item_stem: Question type and stem supplied as an untrusted data block.
knowledge_candidates: Knowledge point candidates supplied as an untrusted data block.
page_content: Source pages supplied as an untrusted data block.
reference_answer: A reference answer supplied as an untrusted data block.
solve_attempt: Independent solver attempt identifier used to keep cached calls separate.
